items.title: Ncell年度套餐：6,999卢比锁定12个月，每月高速数据200GB
items.titleEn: Ncell offers a 12-month pack for NPR 6,999 with 200 GB high-speed data monthly
items.text: Ncell官网确认，预付费用户可在10月12日至11月16日期间购买6,999尼泊尔卢比的12个月套餐，包含国内通话、每日150条短信及每月200GB高速数据；用完后限速256Kbps，至下一月重置。本次为零售套餐促销，不是网络设备采购公告。
items.textEn: Ncell's official offer is available to prepaid users from 12 October to 16 November at NPR 6,999 for 12 months. It includes domestic calls, 150 SMS daily and 200 GB of high-speed data each month, followed by 256 Kbps until the next monthly reset. This is a retail promotion, not a network-equipment procurement notice.
items.opportunity: 研判：年度预付可能加强用户留存，但实际销量、流失率和网络负载尚未披露。下一步检查套餐条款变化及用户使用情况，再评估计费配置和容量优化需求；不能据此认定已启动采购或由某厂家获单。
items.opportunityEn: Analysis: annual prepayment may support retention, but sales, churn and network load are undisclosed. Check changes to offer terms and usage before assessing billing configuration or capacity optimisation; no procurement or vendor award is established.

items.title: 大使提名听证：10人通过，2人被否决，日本提名暂缓
items.titleEn: Ambassadorial hearings clear ten nominees, reject two and defer Japan decision
items.badge: 听证程序 · 非正式任命
items.text: NepalKhabar与《加德满都邮报》确认，10月14日听证委员会通过驻印度、中国、美国等10国的大使提名。后续报道确认，驻沙特和马来西亚提名被否决，驻日本提名暂缓决定。获通过者仍须完成后续任命程序及驻在国同意等步骤，不能列为已履职大使；对被否决者的指控不作为已裁定事实转述。
items.textEn: NepalKhabar and The Kathmandu Post report that on 14 October the hearing committee cleared ten ambassadorial nominees, including those for India, China and the US. Subsequent reporting confirms rejection of the Saudi Arabia and Malaysia nominees and deferral of the Japan decision. Cleared nominees still face remaining appointment procedures and receiving-state consent; they are not treated as serving ambassadors. Allegations concerning rejected nominees are not presented as adjudicated facts.
items.opportunity: 研判：外交联络名录需要保留“提名／听证／任命／到任”分阶段状态。下一步核对总统任命公告及外交部驻外名录；在正式任命前继续使用现有使馆渠道。此次人事程序不直接构成ICT项目或融资承诺。
items.opportunityEn: Analysis: maintain separate nomination, hearing, appointment and arrival stages in diplomatic contact records. Check presidential appointment notices and the foreign ministry's mission directory; retain existing embassy channels until appointments are formalised. This personnel process establishes no ICT project or financing commitment.
